documents.title: Python Classes Guide
documents.text:
Classes in Python. A class bundles data and behaviour. Define one with the class keyword:
class Animal:
    def __init__(self, name, sound):
        self.name = name
        self.sound = sound
    def speak(self):
        return f"{self.name} says {self.sound}"
Create an instance by calling the class: pet = Animal("Rex", "woof") and then pet.speak() returns "Rex says woof".
Inheritance. A subclass reuses a parent class: class Dog(Animal): def __init__(self, name): super().__init__(name, "woof"). Calling super().__init__ runs the parent constructor so the shared attributes are set up once.
Properties. The @property decorator turns a method into a read-only attribute, so code such as circle.area reads like a field while the value is computed on demand.
Special methods. Dunder methods customise behaviour: __repr__ controls how an object prints in the console, __eq__ defines what == means, and __len__ makes len(obj) work.
Class attributes versus instance attributes. A variable assigned directly in the class body, such as legs = 4, is shared by every instance. A variable assigned through self inside __init__ belongs to one instance only.
Common interview question: what is the difference between a class method and a static method? A classmethod receives the class as its first argument (cls) while a staticmethod receives neither the class nor the instance.
List comprehensions. squares = [n * n for n in range(10) if n % 2 == 0] builds a list of the squares of the even numbers below ten in one line.
Exceptions. Wrap risky code in try and except blocks, and use finally for cleanup that must always run, such as closing a file.

documents.title: Plans and Pricing
documents.text:
Plan | Seats | Price per month | Storage | Support
Starter | 3 | $12 | 50 GB | Email only
Team | 15 | $49 | 500 GB | Email and chat
Business | 60 | $189 | 2 TB | Phone, email and chat
Enterprise | Unlimited | Custom quote | Unlimited | Dedicated account manager
Annual billing. Paying for twelve months up front gives two months free on every plan except Enterprise.
Add-ons. Extra storage costs $4 per additional 100 GB per month. Extra seats on the Team plan cost $3.50 each per month.
Trial. Every new account gets a 14 day free trial of the Team plan, and no credit card is needed to start it.
Cancellation. You can cancel at any time from the billing page, and the plan stays active until the end of the period you already paid for.

documents.text:
RESIDENTIAL  LEASE  AGREE-
MENT. This agree- ment is made between the Landlord and the Tenant named  above.
1. TERM. The lease begins on 1 March and runs for twelve (12) months unless ter- minated earlier in accordance with this agreement.
2. RENT. The Tenant shall pay monthly rent of $1,450 on or be- fore the first day of each month. A late fee of $75 applies to any payment received more than 5 days after the due date.
3. SECURITY  DEPOSIT. A deposit equal to one month's rent is held by the Landlord and returned within 30 days after the Tenant moves out, less any deduc- tions for damage beyond normal wear.
4. PETS. No animals are permitted on the premises without prior written consent of the Land- lord. An approved pet carries an additional deposit of $300.
5. UTILITIES. The Tenant is responsible for electricity and internet. Water, sewer and trash col- lection are included in the rent.
6. NOTICE. Either party must give sixty (60) days written notice before ending the tenancy at the end of the term.
